memory_candidates.title: Fuel-exhaustion openBranch lemmas: dischargeable restatement is equivalent to call-site fuel-sufficiency
memory_candidates.content: For a deterministic fuel-bounded tableau loop whose fuel-0 arm returns the first open branch, any added precondition making an 'openBranch result implies saturation' lemma provable must be preserved through the fuel induction (IH reaches fuel 0 mid-run) and dischargeable at the concrete-fuel call site; by determinism the weakest such precondition is 'the run does not exhaust fuel with an open branch', i.e. fuel-sufficiency itself. Cheap preconditions (0 < fuel, initial-saturation, fuel-stability across consecutive fuels) all fail one of the two requirements — checked concretely against intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat and applicable to the S4 loop-checking termination obligations.
